summary_en: This study compares a 5-day course with a 9-day course of whole breast radiation therapy with a boost for early-stage breast cancer. Participants receive hypofractionated radiation therapy, given over either 5 days or 9 days. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2 randomized trial.
summary_es: Este estudio compara un curso de 5 días con un curso de 9 días de radioterapia de toda la mama con refuerzo (boost) para el cáncer de mama en etapa temprana. Los participantes reciben radioterapia hipofraccionada, administrada en un curso de 5 días o de 9 días. El resultado principal no se indica; es un ensayo aleatorizado de fase 2.
who_for: Women aged 18 or older with invasive breast cancer or ductal carcinoma in situ.
Stage T0 to T3, N0, M0 by AJCC v8, with T0 N0 allowed if whole breast radiation is recommended.
Lumpectomy within 84 days before radiation starts, with negative inked margins.
At least one listed risk factor, such as grade 3 histology, age 50 or younger, or tumor larger than 2 cm.
ECOG performance status 2 or less, or KPS 50 or more.
not_for: Prior chest radiation or prior chemotherapy.
Recurrent disease, known metastases, or node-positive disease.
Prior breast malignancy in either breast.
Uncontrolled significant illness, such as heart failure, or a stroke, heart attack, or blood clot within 3 months.
cancer_types: ductal carcinoma in situ of the breast
